findings.paper: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
findings.key_technique: RNN + Monte Carlo dropout for calibrated sequential probability estimates
findings.actionable: Add MC dropout to neural model candidates. GA mutation: add 'rnn_mcdropout' to model_type pool for CPU-capable variant (GRU with p=0.2 dropout, 2-3 layers). Expected Brier improvement: 0.002-0.005.
findings.effort: MEDIUM — add model type to features/engine.py mutation pool

findings.paper: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
findings.key_technique: Stacked ensemble: L1 (XGBoost+LightGBM+RandomForest) -> L2 (logistic regression meta-learner)
findings.insight: Stacking L1 tree models under logistic meta-learner outperforms any single model. Our GA uses single model types — adding stacking as a GA chromosome option could push past 0.22 floor.
findings.actionable: Add 'stacked_ensemble' to model_type pool: L1=[xgboost,lightgbm,random_forest] with 3-fold CV -> L2 logistic. Gate: only for gen>500 (costly to evaluate). Expected improvement: 0.003-0.008.
findings.effort: HIGH — requires engine.py + island mutation changes

findings.paper: A Data-Driven Machine Learning Algorithm for Predicting the Outcomes of NBA Games
findings.key_insight: Logistic regression 0.199 Brier outperforms XGBoost 0.202 — ensemble of simple models beats single complex model
findings.actionable: S14 logistic_regression at 0.22158 confirms this trend. Increase logistic_regression weight in GA initial population seeding (currently equal to tree models).

findings.paper: Integration of machine learning XGBoost and SHAP models for NBA game outcome prediction
findings.key_insight: SHAP feature importance reveals top predictive game factors; pruning correlated features reduces noise
findings.actionable: Run SHAP on S14/S15 best models. Output top-50 SHAP features -> warm-start seed for new island with MAX_FEATURES=50 hard-constrained to SHAP top set.

fleet_lesson_this_cycle.observation: S13 extra_trees recovery: best_brier 0.24535->0.23196 after diversify command
fleet_lesson_this_cycle.lesson: Model-type diversity is critical for escaping local optima. extra_trees discovered a better region than lightgbm was stuck in.
fleet_lesson_this_cycle.recommendation: Ensure all islands cycle through extra_trees, catboost, and random_forest in addition to xgboost/lightgbm. Diversify command should always reset model_type distribution, not just mutation rate.

cross_project_transfer.to_political: Stacked ensemble (L1+L2) applicable to POL. Political has 272 features — stacking could add 0.003-0.005 Brier improvement.
cross_project_transfer.to_political_rnn: RNN+MCDropout: political events as time-series warrants sequential model. Political has natural temporal structure (election cycles, approval ratings).
